name: Qvist 2026
subtitle: F1 CONCEPT
description: Explore Qvist_designs' independent 2026 Formula One concept in 16 groups. The source shape is preserved, with red and graphite finishes. Display seams divide its joined bodywork for an illustrative exploded view; they are not manufacturing joints. This model is not Ferrari SF-26 CAD and does not contain a complete internal power unit.

license.changes: Adapted for APEX: display scale, 16 illustrative component groups, clean cuts in fused bodywork, and red/graphite finishes. Original surface retained; uniform vertex colors removed.

components.name: Front wing
components.description: The layered front wing and endplates meet the airflow first. Explore the curved elements and their connection beneath the nose.

components.name: Nose & chassis
components.description: The central body runs from the tapered nose to the cockpit and rear structure. It remains the reference around which the other groups separate.

components.name: Front left wheel
components.description: The front left tyre and wheel move out together, revealing the suspension and hub behind them. Left and right follow the driver's seating position.

components.name: Front right wheel
components.description: The front right tyre and wheel form one separate shell in the original model. Orbit the car to inspect the inner and outer wheel faces.

components.name: Front suspension
components.description: Paired suspension links, hub surfaces and nearby wheel hardware connect the front corners to the central body. They lift together as a display group.

components.name: Left sidepod
components.description: The sculpted left flank wraps around the cooling inlet and narrows towards the rear. Its display cut exposes the shape of the outer bodywork.

components.name: Right sidepod
components.description: The right sidepod mirrors the flowing outer profile on the opposite side. Compare its upper surface, undercut and relationship to the floor.

components.name: Floor & diffuser
components.description: The low underbody, floor edges and rear diffuser form the base of the concept. This group stays in place while the bodywork lifts away.

components.name: Halo
components.description: The curved cockpit protection structure rises above the driver's opening. Its mounting region is divided from the fused source body for this view.

components.name: Airbox & engine cover
components.description: The air intake, upper engine cover and fin lift above the central body. These are exterior surfaces; the source does not supply a complete engine underneath.

components.name: Rear suspension
components.description: The rear links and hub surfaces sit between the body and rear wheels. Separation reveals their arrangement around the exhaust and diffuser.

components.name: Rear left wheel
components.description: The broad rear left tyre and wheel separate as the intact source shell. Compare its width and wheel face with the front corner.

components.name: Rear right wheel
components.description: The rear right wheel moves outward to expose the inner running gear. Its tyre and wheel geometry remain together throughout disassembly.

components.name: Rear wing
components.description: The high rear wing, endplates and central supports move behind the car. Orbit above it to inspect the layered wing surfaces.

components.name: Mirrors
components.description: The paired mirror housings and their upper supports lift away from either side of the cockpit. Their geometry comes from the original concept.

components.name: Exhaust outlet
components.description: The central exhaust outlet is a separate shell in the source model. It slides rearward to reveal its visible exterior shape.
